Defining the prediction landscapes and some preliminary plotting to verify.
```{r}
focal.extent <- ext(c(range(fisher.focal$x_, na.rm = T) + 1000*c(-1,1),range(fisher.focal$y_, na.rm = T)+ 1000*c(-1,1)))
non.focal.extent <- ext(c(range(fisher.nonfocal$x_, na.rm = T)+ 1000*c(-1,1),range(fisher.nonfocal$y_, na.rm = T)+ 1000*c(-1,1)))

focal <- rstack.focal
focal <- crop(focal, ext(focal.extent))

nonfocal <- rstack.nonfocal

nonfocal <- crop(nonfocal, ext(non.focal.extent))

dist.nat <- ifelse(values(focal$DistWetland) <= values(focal$DistForest), values(focal$DistWetland), values(focal$DistForest))
focal$DistForWet <- setValues(focal$DistWetland, dist.nat)

dist.nat <- ifelse(values(nonfocal$DistWetland) <= values(nonfocal$DistForest), values(nonfocal$DistWetland), values(nonfocal$DistForest))
nonfocal$DistForWet <- setValues(nonfocal$DistWetland, dist.nat)

focal <- crop(focal, focal.extent)
nonfocal <- crop(nonfocal, non.focal.extent)

focal$ForWet <- focal$DistForWet == 0
nonfocal$ForWet <- nonfocal$DistForWet == 0

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(sqrt(focal$DistForest))
plot(sqrt(focal$DistForest))
points(train.fisher$x_, train.fisher$y_, col = "black", pch = ".")
points(test.fisher$x_, test.fisher$y_, col = "red", pch = ".")
plot(focal)

par(mfrow = c(1,2), oma = c(0,0,0,1))
plot(sqrt(nonfocal$DistForest))
plot(sqrt(nonfocal$DistForest))
points(Focal$x_[Focal$id == "M5"], Focal$y_[Focal$id == "M5"], col = "red", pch = ".")
plot(nonfocal)
```

Again, we are using map to contain the same pipeline as above.
```{r}
train.fisher %>%
  nest(data = -c("id")) %>%
  mutate(median = lapply(data, function(d) { round(as.numeric(median(diff(d$t_), na.rm = T), units = "mins"))})) %>% 
  select(median) %>% 
  unnest()

train.fisher.use <- train.fisher %>%
  nest(data = -c("id")) %>%
  mutate(data = lapply(data,
                      function(d) {
                        make_track(d, x_, y_, t_, group) %>%
                          track_resample(rate = minutes(30), tolerance = minutes(5))}))

ind <- train.fisher.use %>%
  mutate(trk = lapply(data,
                      function(d) {
                        d %>%
                          steps_by_burst(keep_cols = "start")
                      })) %>%
  mutate(dist = map(trk, function(x) {
    fatter.unif <- fit_distr(x$sl_, "unif")
    fatter.unif$params$min <- 0
    fatter.unif$params$max <- fatter.unif$params$max*1.25
    attributes(fatter.unif)$class[2] <- "sl_distr"
    fatter.unif
  })) %>% 
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(steps = map2(trk, dist, function(x,y) {
    if("Focal" %in% x$group) {
      data <- x %>%
        random_steps(100,
                     sl_distr = y) %>%
        extract_covariates(focal)
    }
    if("Non-focal" %in% x$group) {
      data <- x %>%
        random_steps(100,
                     sl_distr = y) %>%
        extract_covariates(nonfocal)
    }
    data
  }))

m <- ind %>% 
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(model = map(steps, function(x) {
    x %>% drop_na() %>%
      fit_clogit(case_ ~ sqrt(DistForest) + sl_ + log(sl_) + strata(step_id_), model = T)
  }))

mock.surface <- create_mock_surface(focal, F, list(x = xres(focal), y = yres(focal)))

pred.data <- get_cells(m$model[[1]],
                       mock.surface,
                       focal)
pred.data <- pred.data %>%
  arrange(cellnr)
cell.data <- get_cell_data(m$model[[1]], pred.data)
cell.data.list <- pbmclapply(as.list(1:dim(cell.data)[1]), function(x) cell.data[x[1],])
neighbors.found <- neighbor_lookup(mock.surface, cell.data, cell.data.list = cell.data.list)

sparse.neighbors <- neighbor_finder(NA, cell.data, neighbors.found, cell.data.list = cell.data.list, distance.override = max(sapply(m$trk, function(x) quantile(x$sl_, 0.95))))
ssf.comparisons <- compile_ssf_comparisons(sparse.neighbors, cell.data)

predicted.surfaces <- m %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map(model, function(x) {
    predict_ssf_comparisons(x, ssf.comparisons)
  }))

graphs <- predicted.surfaces %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(graph = map(surfaces, function(x) {
    A <- x$prob.matrix # matrix A
    d <- eigs(t(A), 1) # eigen decomp
    d.1 <- Re(d$vectors[,1]) # first vector
    prob.d.deer <- d.1/sum(d.1) # make sure it sums to 1
    ssd.raster.deer <- setValues(mock.surface, prob.d.deer)
    ssd.raster.deer
  }))
ssdpredictions <- rast(graphs$graph)
names(ssdpredictions) <- graphs$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssdpredictions))

ssf.surfaces <- m %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(model, trk, function(x,y) {
    a.data <- pred.data # grab prior matrix data
    a.data$sl_ <- mean(y$sl_, na.rm = T) # use mean step length
    b.data <- a.data[1,] # set the first cell as the baseline

    log.rss <- amt::log_rss(x, # the model
                            a.data, # the raster data (including missing values)
                            b.data,  # a row of the raster data (excluding missing values)
                            ci = NA)
    ssf <-  exp(log.rss$df$log_rss)/sum(exp(log.rss$df$log_rss)) # turn into kernel after making values positive
    setValues(mock.surface, ssf)
  }))

ssfpredictions <- rast(ssf.surfaces$surfaces)
names(ssfpredictions) <- graphs$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssfpredictions))

rsf.surfaces <- m %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(data, trk, function(x,y) {
    if("Focal" %in% x$group) {
      rsf.data <- x %>% filter(!is.na(x_) & !(is.na(y_))) %>%
        make_track(x_, y_, t_) %>%
        random_points() %>% # defaults
        extract_covariates(focal) # grab distance
    }
    if("Non-focal" %in% x$group) {
      rsf.data <- x %>% filter(!is.na(x_) & !(is.na(y_))) %>%
        make_track(x_, y_, t_) %>%
        random_points() %>% # defaults
        extract_covariates(nonfocal) # grab distance
    }

    rsf.m <- rsf.data %>%
      fit_rsf(case_ ~  sqrt(DistForest), model = T) # fit model
    probabilities <- exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data))/(1+exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data))) # get to probabilities
    probabilities <- ifelse(probabilities == "NaN", NA, probabilities)
    probabilities.kern <- probabilities/sum(probabilities, na.rm = T)
    setValues(mock.surface, probabilities.kern)
  }))


rsfpredictions <- rast(rsf.surfaces$surfaces)
names(rsfpredictions) <- graphs$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((rsfpredictions))

plot(c((ssdpredictions)[[1]],(ssfpredictions)[[1]],(rsfpredictions)[[1]]))
```


Now that we have the focal predictions (a shared landscape), let's look at a nonfocal landscape (a different landscape)
```{r}
mock.surface. <- create_mock_surface(nonfocal, F, list(x = xres(nonfocal), y = yres(nonfocal)))

pred.data. <- get_cells(m$model[[1]],
                       mock.surface.,
                       nonfocal)
pred.data. <- pred.data. %>%
  arrange(cellnr)
cell.data. <- get_cell_data(m$model[[1]], pred.data.)
cell.data.list. <- pbmclapply(as.list(1:dim(cell.data.)[1]), function(x) cell.data.[x[1],])
neighbors.found. <- neighbor_lookup(mock.surface., cell.data., cell.data.)
sparse.neighbors. <- neighbor_finder(NA, cell.data., neighbors.found., quantile = 0.95, cell.data.list = cell.data.list., distance.override = max(sapply(m$trk, function(x) quantile(x$sl_, 0.95))))
ssf.comparisons. <- compile_ssf_comparisons(sparse.neighbors., cell.data.)

predicted.surfaces. <- m %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map(model, function(x) {
    predict_ssf_comparisons(x, ssf.comparisons.)
  }))

graphs. <- predicted.surfaces. %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(graph = map(surfaces, function(x) {
    A <- x$prob.matrix # matrix A
    d <- eigs(t(A), 1) # eigen decomp
    d.1 <- Re(d$vectors[,1]) # first vector
    prob.d.deer <- d.1/sum(d.1) # make sure it sums to 1
    ssd.raster.deer <- setValues(mock.surface., prob.d.deer)
    ssd.raster.deer
  }))

ssdpredictions. <- rast(graphs.$graph)
names(ssdpredictions.) <- graphs.$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssdpredictions.))

ssf.surfaces. <- m %>%
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(model, trk, function(x,y) {
    a.data <- pred.data. # grab prior matrix data
    a.data$sl_ <- mean(y$sl_, na.rm = T) # use mean step length
    b.data <- a.data[1,] # set the first cell as the baseline

    log.rss <- amt::log_rss(x, # the model
                            a.data, # the raster data (including missing values)
                            b.data,  # a row of the raster data (excluding missing values)
                            ci = NA)
    ssf <-  exp(log.rss$df$log_rss)/sum(exp(log.rss$df$log_rss)) # turn into kernel after making values positive
    setValues(mock.surface., ssf)
  }))

ssfpredictions. <- rast(ssf.surfaces.$surfaces)
names(ssfpredictions.) <- graphs$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssfpredictions.))

rsf.surfaces. <- m %>% 
  filter(id != "M5") %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(data, trk, function(x,y) {
    if("Focal" %in% x$group) {
      rsf.data <- x %>% filter(!is.na(x_) & !(is.na(y_))) %>% 
        make_track(x_, y_, t_) %>% 
        random_points() %>% # defaults
        extract_covariates(focal) # grab distance
    }
    if("Non-focal" %in% x$group) {
      rsf.data <- x %>% filter(!is.na(x_) & !(is.na(y_))) %>% 
        make_track(x_, y_, t_) %>% 
        random_points() %>% # defaults
        extract_covariates(nonfocal) # grab distance
    }
    
    rsf.m <- rsf.data %>% 
      fit_rsf(case_ ~ sqrt(DistForest), model = T) # fit model
    probabilities <- exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data.))/(1+exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data.))) # get to probabilities
    probabilities <- ifelse(probabilities == "NaN", NA, probabilities)
    probabilities.kern <- probabilities/sum(probabilities, na.rm = T)

rsfpredictions. <- rast(rsf.surfaces.$surfaces)
```

### Comparisons
Now we can compare all of the abilities of the surfaces to the observed intensity of use for individuals in the future (in), for other individuals in the same place (out), and for new environments (new).
```{r}
focal.pred <- c(ssdpredictions, ssfpredictions, rsfpredictions, abmpredictions.fisher)
non.focal.pred <- c(ssdpredictions., ssfpredictions., rsfpredictions., abmpredictions.fisher.nonfocal)
names(focal.pred) <- paste(rep(c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), each = 7), rep(graphs$id, 4), "Focal")
names(non.focal.pred) <- paste(rep(c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), each = 7), rep(graphs$id, 4), "Nonfocal")

pred.values <- as.data.frame(values(focal.pred))

shannon.fisher <- pred.values %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(pred.values))) %>% 
  mutate(model = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,1],
         animal = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,2]) %>% 
  group_by(model, animal) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("SSD","SSF","RSF", "ABM"))) %>% 
  summarize(shannon = -sum(ifelse(value == 0, 0, value*log(value)))) %>% 
  group_by(animal) 

shannon.fisher %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = shannon, color = animal, group = animal)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_scico_d(begin = 0.5) +
  theme_classic()

non.focal.pred.values <- as.data.frame(values(non.focal.pred))

non.focal.pred.values %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(non.focal.pred.values))) %>% 
  mutate(model = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,1],
         animal = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,2]) %>% 
  group_by(model, animal) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("SSD","SSF","RSF", "ABM"))) %>% 
  summarize(shannon = -sum(ifelse(value == 0, 0, value*log(value)))) %>% 
  group_by(animal) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = shannon, color = animal, group = animal)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_scico_d(begin = 0.5) +
  theme_linedraw()

use.area.fisher <- pred.values %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(pred.values))) %>% 
  mutate(model = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,1],
         animal = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,2]) %>% 
  group_by(model, animal) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("SSD","SSF","RSF", "ABM"))) %>% 
  arrange(-value) %>% 
  mutate(cdf = cumsum(value)) %>% 
  summarize(sum = sum(cdf <= 0.5))

use.area.fisher %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = sum, color = animal, group = animal)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path()
```

```{r}
         bootstrap = factor(bootstrap),
         in.out = type.names,

         model = factor(model, levels = c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF","ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  mutate(in.out = factor(in.out, levels = c("In-Sample","Within Individual", "Between Individuals", "Between Contexts"), ordered = T))

correlations.fisher.mean$type <- "Geometric Mean"

bound.comparisons.fisher <- rbind(correlations.fisher.spearman, correlations.fisher.mean)

fisher.data <- bound.comparisons.fisher %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF","ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  mutate(in.out = factor(in.out, levels = c("In-Sample", "Within Individual", "Between Individuals", "Between Contexts"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name) %>% 
  group_by(id, in.out, model, type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(model), values_from = measure) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(RSF, SSF, ABM)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = SSD-value) %>%
  group_by(id, in.out, name, type) %>%
  summarize(median = median(delta, na.rm = T),
            lower = quantile(delta, 0.025, na.rm = T),
            upper = quantile(delta, 0.975, na.rm = T)) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(median, lower, upper))
  mutate(model = factor(name, levels = c("RSF","SSF","ABM"), labels = c("SSD-RSF","SSD-SSF","SSD-ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  group_by(in.out, id, type) %>% 
  mutate(top = median == max(median, na.rm = T))


fisher.data %>% 
  arrange(model) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = median, ymax = upper, ymin = lower, shape = type, group = paste(id), color = id)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_path(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  facet_grid(type~in.out, scales = "free_y") +  
  labs(x = "Prediction Comparison",
       y = "Difference from SSD Prediction\n(Median and 95% Quantile)",
       shape = "Comparison Heuristic") + 
  theme_classic() +
  scale_alpha_discrete(guide = F, range = c(0.5, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "both.sqrt.trans_trans")
```

We can scale up our projections to think about other individuals in *different* places.

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=10, fig.dpi=300}
buffalo <- readRDS("Casestudies/buffalo.data.RDS")
boundaries <- st_read("Casestudies/KNPShape/2017_kruger_national_park.shp")

# st_write(boundaries, "KNPOriginalboundaries.shp")

buffalo <- buffalo %>% dplyr::select(c("id", "group", "x_", "y_", "t_"))

buffalo.hr <- buffalo %>%
  nest(data = -c("id")) %>%
  mutate(trk = lapply(data,
                      function(d) {
                         make_track(d, x_, y_, t_, group) 
                      })) %>%
  mutate(hr = map(trk, function(x) {
    hr_kde(x)
  }))

hr.est <- rbindlist(lapply(buffalo.hr$hr, function(x) {hr_area(x)}))
hr.est <- hr.est %>% mutate(radius = sqrt(area/pi)) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(radius))
hr.est

buffalo %>%
  arrange(t_) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_, y = y_, color = id)) +
  geom_sf(data = boundaries, color = "black", fill = NA, inherit.aes = F) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_sf() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  theme_linedraw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

buffalo %>%
  arrange(t_) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_, y = y_, color = id)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_sf() +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  theme_linedraw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

Filtering out historic movements from the future movements we want to predict
```{r}
buffalo <- buffalo %>% group_by(id) %>% filter(!is.na(x_)) %>% arrange(t_) %>% mutate(row = 1:n()) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(unique = 1:n()) 
train.buffalo <- buffalo %>% group_by(id) %>% filter(row %in% 1:round(n()*.75))
test.buffalo <- buffalo %>% filter(!unique %in% train.buffalo$unique)

train.buffalo %>%
  group_by(group,id) %>%
  tally()

test.buffalo %>%
  group_by(group,id) %>%
  tally()
```


We can also read in geospatial info, and alter it to suite reasonable info for species movements.

Again, we are using map to contain the same pipeline as above.
```{r}
set.seed(100)
ind <- train.buffalo %>%
  nest(data = -c("id")) %>%
  mutate(trk = lapply(data,
                      function(d) {
                        difference <- round(as.numeric(median(diff(d$t_), na.rm = T), units = "mins"))
                        make_track(d, x_, y_, t_, group) %>%
                          track_resample(rate = hours(5), tolerance = minutes(10)) %>%
                          steps_by_burst(keep_cols = "start")
                      })) %>%
  mutate(dist = map(trk, function(x) {
    fatter.unif <- fit_distr(x$sl_, "unif")
    fatter.unif$params$min <- 0
    fatter.unif$params$max <- fatter.unif$params$max*1.25
    attributes(fatter.unif)$class[2] <- "sl_distr"
    fatter.unif
  })) %>%
  mutate(steps = map2(trk, dist, function(x,y) {
      data <- x %>%
        random_steps(100,
                     sl_distr = y) %>%
        extract_covariates(buffalo.envi2)
    data
  }))

min(unlist(lapply(ind$trk, function(x) quantile(x$sl_, 0.95, na.rm = T))))
max(unlist(lapply(ind$trk, function(x) quantile(x$sl_, 0.95, na.rm = T))))

m <- ind %>% 
  mutate(model = map(steps, function(x) {
    x %>% drop_na() %>%
      fit_clogit(case_ ~ water.min + wood + (sl_ + log(sl_)) + strata(step_id_), model = T)
  }))

buffalo.envi2.surf <- c(buffalo.envi2)
mock.surface <- create_mock_surface(buffalo.envi2.surf, F, list(x = xres(buffalo.envi2.surf), y = yres(buffalo.envi2.surf)))
pred.data <- get_cells(m$model[[1]],
                       mock.surface,
                       buffalo.envi2.surf)
pred.data <- pred.data %>%
  arrange(cellnr)
cell.data <- get_cell_data(m$model[[1]], pred.data)
cell.data.list <- pbmclapply(as.list(1:dim(cell.data)[1]), function(x) cell.data[x[1],])

neighbors.found <- neighbor_lookup(mock.surface, cell.data, cell.data.list = cell.data.list)

index.keep <- which(!is.na(cell.data$lRSS))

# sparse.neighbors <- neighbor_finder(NA, cell.data[index.keep,], neighbors.found, cell.data.list = cell.data.list[index.keep], distance.override = max(sapply(m$trk, function(x) quantile(x$sl_, 0.95))))
# 
# saveRDS(sparse.neighbors, "Casestudies/buffalo.sparse.neighbors.RDS")
sparse.neighbors <- readRDS("Casestudies/buffalo.sparse.neighbors.RDS")



ssf.comparisons <- pblapply(sparse.neighbors$by.cell, function(x){ 
    baseline <- cell.data[x$column[which(x$distance == 0)],] # baseline will have a distance of zero (focal)
    
    baseline$sl_ <- 0 # create a variable "step" that records this zero distance
    
    alternate <- cell.data[x$column,] # grab all the other cell.data for neighboring cells (including focal cell)
    
    alternate$sl_ <- x$distance # force distance to this new variable step
    
    list(.given = baseline[,c("wood","water.min","cellnr","sl_")], .for = alternate[,c("wood","water.min","cellnr","sl_")]) # return a list of focal and neigboring cell data
    
  })

rm(sparse.neighbors)
gc()

raster.pred <- buffalo.envi2.surf$wood
store.rast <- rep(list(NA),6)
for(i in 1:6){
  gc()
  A <- predict_ssf_comparisons(m$model[[i]], ssf.comparisons)$prob.matrix[,index.keep]
  gc()
  d <- eigs(t(A), 1) # eigen decomp
  d.1 <- Re(d$vectors[,1]) # first vector
  prob.d.buff <- d.1/sum(d.1) # make sure it sums to 1
  values(raster.pred)[index.keep] <- prob.d.buff
  store.rast[[i]] <- raster.pred
  plot(raster.pred)
}

rm(ssf.comparisons)

ssdpredictions.buffalo <- rast(store.rast)
names(ssdpredictions.buffalo) <- m$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssdpredictions.buffalo))

set.seed(100)
ssf.surfaces <- m %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(model, trk, function(x,y) {
    a.data <- pred.data # grab prior matrix data
    a.data$sl_ <- mean(y$sl_, na.rm = T) # use mean step length
    b.data <- a.data[54,] # set the first non-NA cell as the baseline

    log.rss <- amt::log_rss(x, # the model
                            a.data, # the raster data (including missing values)
                            b.data,  # a row of the raster data (excluding missing values)
                            ci = NA)
    ssf <-  exp(log.rss$df$log_rss)/sum(exp(log.rss$df$log_rss), na.rm = T) # turn into kernel after making values positive
    setValues(mock.surface, ssf)
  }))

ssfpredictions.buffalo <- rast(ssf.surfaces$surfaces)
names(ssfpredictions.buffalo) <- m$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((ssfpredictions.buffalo))

rsf.surfaces <- m %>%
  mutate(surfaces = map2(data, trk, function(x,y) {
    
      rsf.data <- x %>% filter(!is.na(x_) & !(is.na(y_))) %>%
        make_track(x_, y_, t_) %>%
        random_points() %>% # defaults
        extract_covariates(buffalo.envi2) # grab distance

    rsf.m <- rsf.data %>%
      fit_rsf(case_ ~ water.min + wood , model = T) # fit model
    probabilities <- exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data))/(1+exp(predict(rsf.m$model, newdata = pred.data))) # get to probabilities
    probabilities <- ifelse(probabilities == "NaN", NA, probabilities)
    probabilities.kern <- probabilities/sum(probabilities, na.rm = T)
    setValues(mock.surface, probabilities.kern)
  }))


rsfpredictions.buffalo <- rast(rsf.surfaces$surfaces)
names(rsfpredictions.buffalo) <- m$id
par(oma = c(0,0,0,2))
plot((rsfpredictions.buffalo))
```

### Comparisons
Now we can compare all of the abilities of the surfaces to the observed intensity of use for individuals in the future (in), for other individuals in the same place (out), and for new environments (new).
```{r}
focal.pred <- c(ssdpredictions.buffalo, ssfpredictions.buffalo, rsfpredictions.buffalo, abmpredictions.buffalo)
names(focal.pred) <- paste(rep(c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), each = 6), rep(m$id, 4), "Focal")

pred.values <- as.data.frame(values(focal.pred))

shannon.buffalo <- pred.values %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(pred.values))) %>% 
  mutate(model = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,1],
         animal = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,2]) %>% 
  group_by(model, animal) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("SSD","SSF","RSF","ABM"))) %>% 
  summarize(shannon = -sum(value*log(value), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  group_by(animal) 


shannon.buffalo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = shannon, color = animal, group = animal)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_scico_d(begin = 0.5) +
  theme_classic()

use.area.buffalo <- pred.values %>% 
  pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(pred.values))) %>% 
  mutate(model = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,1],
         animal = str_split(name, " ",simplify = T)[,2]) %>% 
  group_by(model, animal) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, c("SSD","SSF","RSF","ABM"))) %>% 
  arrange(-value) %>% 
  mutate(cdf = cumsum(value)) %>% 
  summarize(sum = sum(cdf <= 0.5, na.rm = T))

use.area.buffalo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = sum, color = animal, group = animal)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path()
```

```{r}
                        subset(focal.pred, seq(5, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Pepper.in <- compare_mean(train.buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), id == "Pepper") %>% make_track(x_,y_) %>% ungroup(),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(6, 24, by = 6)), iter)
Pepper.id <- compare_mean(test.buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), id == "Pepper") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(6, 24, by = 6)), iter)
Pepper.out <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), id != "Pepper", group == "North") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                        subset(focal.pred, seq(6, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Queen.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "South") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(1, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Gabs.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "North") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(2, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Cilla.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "North") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(3, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Mvubu.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "North") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(4, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Toni.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "South") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(5, 24, by = 6)), iter)

Pepper.new <- compare_mean(buffalo %>% filter(!is.na(x_), group == "South") %>% make_track(x_,y_),
                       subset(focal.pred, seq(6, 24, by = 6)), iter)


correlations.buffalo.mean <- rbind(Queen.in,Queen.id,Queen.out,Gabs.in,Gabs.id,Gabs.out,Cilla.in,Cilla.id,Cilla.out,Mvubu.in,Mvubu.id,Mvubu.out,Toni.in,Toni.id,Toni.out,Pepper.in,Pepper.id,Pepper.out,Queen.new,Gabs.new,Cilla.new,Mvubu.new,Toni.new,Pepper.new) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(id = id.names,
         bootstrap = factor(bootstrap),
         in.out = type.names,
         model = case_when(str_detect(name, "RSF") ~ "RSF", str_detect(name, "SSF") ~ "SSF", str_detect(name, "SSD") ~ "SSD", str_detect(name, "ABM") ~ "ABM"),
         model = factor(model, levels = c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  mutate(in.out = factor(in.out, levels = c("In-Sample","Within Individual", "Between Individuals", "Between Contexts"), ordered = T))


correlations.buffalo.spearman$type <- "Spearman"
correlations.buffalo.mean$type <- "Geometric Mean"

bound.comparisons.buffalo <- rbind(correlations.buffalo.spearman, correlations.buffalo.mean)

buffalo.data <- bound.comparisons.buffalo %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  mutate(in.out = factor(in.out, levels = c("In-Sample", "Within Individual", "Between Individuals", "Between Contexts"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name) %>% 
  group_by(id, in.out, model, type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(model), values_from = measure) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(RSF, SSF,ABM)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = SSD-value) %>%
  group_by(id, in.out, name, type) %>%
  summarize(median = median(delta),
            lower = quantile(delta, 0.025),
            upper = quantile(delta, 0.975)) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(median, lower, upper))
  mutate(model = factor(name, levels = c("RSF","SSF","ABM"), labels = c("SSD-RSF","SSD-SSF","SSD-ABM"), ordered = T)) %>% 
  group_by(in.out, id, type) %>% 
  mutate(top = median == max(median))


buffalo.data %>% 
  arrange(model) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = median, ymax = upper, ymin = lower, shape = type, group = paste(id), color = id)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_path(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  facet_grid(type~in.out, scales = "free_y") +  
  labs(x = "Prediction Comparison",
       y = "Difference from SSD Prediction\n(Median and 95% Quantile)",
       shape = "Comparison Heuristic") + 
  theme_classic() +
  scale_alpha_discrete(guide = F, range = c(0.5, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "both.sqrt.trans_trans")
```

## Buffalo Density Extension 


### Modeling point process

```{r}
buffalo_locations <- read.csv("Casestudies/buffalo_locations.csv")
buffalo_locations <- buffalo_locations %>%
  select(t.rand, X, Y, TOTAL)
colnames(buffalo_locations) <- c("Year.random","Easting","Northing","Total")

length(unique(buffalo_locations$Year.random))

indep_vect <- vect(buffalo_locations, geom = c("Easting", "Northing"), crs = crs(boundaries))

boundaries.v <- vect(boundaries)

indep_vect_crop <- terra::crop(indep_vect, boundaries.v)

pred <- c((ssdpredictions.buffalo), (ssfpredictions.buffalo), (rsfpredictions.buffalo), abmpredictions.buffalo, (mean((ssdpredictions.buffalo))), (mean(((ssfpredictions.buffalo)))), (mean(((rsfpredictions.buffalo)))), mean(abmpredictions.buffalo)) # all predictions and their average

names(pred) <- c(paste(rep(c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM"), each = 6), rep(m$id, 3)), "SSD Mean","SSF Mean","RSF Mean","ABM Mean")

true <- st_as_sf(indep_vect_crop) # true locations

true.int <- terra::extract((pred), true) # pulling values

bound <- true.int 
bound$total <- true$Total 
bound$t <- c(true$Year.random)

bound$id.row <- 1:nrow(bound)

bound$X <- c(st_coordinates(true)[,1])#, st_coordinates(random)[,1])
bound$Y <- c(st_coordinates(true)[,2])#, st_coordinates(random)[,2])


# year here is uninformative temporally - this will serve as a random effect in later PPMs
bound %>% 
  arrange(total) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = X, y = Y, color = total > 0)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~t, nrow = 3) +
  coord_equal() 
```


```{r}
bound.long <- bound %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c("SSD Mean","SSF Mean","RSF Mean", "ABM Mean")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(names(pred)[1:24]) %>% 
  mutate(animal = str_split(name, " ", simplify = T)[,2],
         method = str_split(name, " ", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("SSD","SSF","RSF","ABM"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("ID","total","t","animal"), names_from = c("method"), values_from = "value") %>% 
  mutate(SSD.s = scale(SSD),
         SSF.s = scale(SSF),
         RSF.s = scale(RSF),
         ABM.s = scale(ABM))

fit.1 <- glmmTMB(total ~ SSD.s + (1|t) + (1|animal),
        data = bound.long , 
        family = nbinom2())
fit.2 <- glmmTMB(total ~ SSF.s + (1|t) + (1|animal),
        data = bound.long, 
        family = nbinom2())
fit.3 <- glmmTMB(total ~ RSF.s + (1|t) + (1|animal),
        data = bound.long, 
        family = nbinom2())
fit.4 <- glmmTMB(total ~ ABM.s + (1|t) + (1|animal),
        data = bound.long, 
        family = nbinom2())


par(mfrow=c(1,4))
plot(density(sqrt(simulate(fit.1)$sim_1)), xlab = "Count", main = "SSD Density PPM")
lines(density(sqrt(bound.long$total[!is.na(bound.long$SSD.s) & bound.long$total >0])), col = "red")

plot(density(sqrt(simulate(fit.2)$sim_1)), xlab = "Count", main = "SSF Density PPM")
lines(density(sqrt(bound.long$total[!is.na(bound.long$SSF.s) & bound.long$total >0])), col = "red")

plot(density(sqrt(simulate(fit.3)$sim_1)), xlab = "Count", main = "RSF Density PPM")
lines(density(sqrt(bound.long$total[!is.na(bound.long$RSF.s) & bound.long$total >0])), col = "red")

plot(density(sqrt(simulate(fit.4)$sim_1)), xlab = "Count", main = "ABM Density PPM")
lines(density(sqrt(bound.long$total[!is.na(bound.long$ABM.s) & bound.long$total >0])), col = "red")
```


```{r}
summary(fit.1)
summary(fit.2)
summary(fit.3)
summary(fit.4)

AIC.comp <- data.frame(AIC(fit.1, fit.2, fit.3, fit.4))

AIC.comp$delta.AIC <- AIC.comp$AIC - min(AIC.comp$AIC)
AIC.comp$weight <- exp(-0.5 * AIC.comp$delta.AIC)/sum(exp(-0.5 * AIC.comp$delta.AIC))

rownames(AIC.comp) <- c("SSD", "SSF", "RSF", "ABM")
AIC.comp

ssd.mod <- tidy(fit.1)
ssf.mod <- tidy(fit.2)
rsf.mod <- tidy(fit.3)
abm.mod <- tidy(fit.4)

write.csv(ssd.mod, "Casestudies/ssd.mod.csv")
write.csv(ssf.mod, "Casestudies/ssf.mod.csv")
write.csv(rsf.mod, "Casestudies/rsf.mod.csv")
write.csv(abm.mod, "Casestudies/abm.mod.csv")
write.csv(AIC.comp, "Casestudies/AIC.comp.csv")
```

```{r fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
use.area.buffalo$data <- "Buffalo"
prediction.maps.2 <- use.area.buffalo %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("RSF", "SSF", "ABM", "SSD"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "model", values_from = "sum") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("RSF", "SSF","ABM")) %>% 
  mutate(change = (SSD - value)/value) %>% 
  mutate(name = factor(name, c("RSF", "SSF","ABM"))) %>% 
  group_by(data, name) %>% 
  mutate(min = min(change),
         max = max(change),
         mean = mean(change)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = mean, x = name, ymin = min, ymax = max)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_pointrange(width = 0.25) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(y=change), position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0), alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_color_scico_d() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
  labs(y = "50% Use Area of SSD Relative to RSF, SSF, and ABM",
       x = "Prediction\nKernel",
       color = "Prediction Type") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(data~.) +
  scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none", range = c(0.25, 1))  

ggsave("Plots/BuffaloEntropy.png", prediction.maps.2, width = 5, height = 5)
```

## Convergence of ABMs

```{r}
convergence.case <- readRDS("Casestudies/store.convergence.case.RDS")


system.size <- tibble(system = c("roe","red","fisher.focal","fisher.nonfocal","buffalo"),
                       ncells = c(sum(!is.na(values(rast.reddeer.abm[[1]]))), 
                                  sum(!is.na(values(rast.roedeer.abm[[1]]))),
                                  sum(!is.na(values(focal[[1]]))),
                                  sum(!is.na(values(nonfocal[[1]]))),
                                  sum(!is.na(values(buffalo.envi2[[1]])))))

convergence <- as.data.frame(convergence.case) %>% 
  mutate(iterations = (1:10000)*10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(colnames(convergence.case)) %>% 
  mutate(system = str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(name, "1"),"2"),"3"),"4"),"5"),"6"),"7"),
         case = str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(str_remove(name, "red"),"roe"),"fisher.focal"),"fisher.nonfocal"),"buffalo"))


convergence <- merge(convergence, system.size, by = "system")


convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  mutate(system = case_when(
    system == "buffalo" ~ "Buffalo",
    system == "fisher.focal" ~ "Fisher (Focal)",
    system == "fisher.nonfocal" ~ "Fisher (Nonfocal)",
    system == "red" ~ "Red Deer",
    system == "roe" ~ "Roe Deer")) %>% 
  mutate(system = factor(system, levels = c("Red Deer", "Roe Deer", "Fisher (Focal)", "Fisher (Nonfocal)", "Buffalo"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = iterations, y = value, color = system, group = name)) +
  geom_polygon(data = convergence %>% 
                 ungroup() %>% 
                 filter(iterations >= 90000) %>% 
                 summarize(x = c(min(iterations),max(iterations),max(iterations),min(iterations)),
                           y = c(0.995,0.995,1.005,1.005)), 
               mapping = aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = F, color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Number of Cells in Landscape",
       y = "BHA vs. 100k iterations",
       color = "System") +
  scale_color_scico_d() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "large.power_trans")

convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  filter(iterations >= 90000) %>% 
  mutate(system = case_when(
    system == "buffalo" ~ "Buffalo",
    system == "fisher.focal" ~ "Fisher (Focal)",
    system == "fisher.nonfocal" ~ "Fisher (Nonfocal)",
    system == "red" ~ "Red Deer",
    system == "roe" ~ "Roe Deer")) %>% 
  mutate(system = factor(system, levels = c("Red Deer", "Roe Deer", "Fisher (Focal)", "Fisher (Nonfocal)", "Buffalo"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = iterations, y = value, color = system, group = name)) +
  geom_path() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Iterations",
       y = "BHA vs. 100k iterations",
       color = "System") +
  scale_color_scico_d() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "large.power_trans")


bha.99 <- convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  filter(value > 0.99) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  mutate(bha = 0.99)

bha.999 <- convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  filter(value > 0.999) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  mutate(bha = 0.999)

bha.9999 <- convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  filter(value > 0.9999) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  mutate(bha = 0.9999)

bha.99999 <- convergence %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  arrange(iterations) %>% 
  filter(value > 0.99999) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  mutate(bha = 0.99999)


rbind(bha.99, bha.999, bha.9999, bha.99999) %>% 
  mutate(system = case_when(
    system == "buffalo" ~ "Buffalo",
    system == "fisher.focal" ~ "Fisher (Focal)",
    system == "fisher.nonfocal" ~ "Fisher (Nonfocal)",
    system == "red" ~ "Red Deer",
    system == "roe" ~ "Roe Deer")) %>% 
  mutate(system = factor(system, levels = c("Red Deer", "Roe Deer", "Fisher (Focal)", "Fisher (Nonfocal)", "Buffalo"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ncells, y = iterations, color = factor(bha), shape = system, group = bha)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(0.01)) +
  geom_smooth(se = F, method = "loess", span = 1000) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Number of Cells in Landscape",
       y = "Iterations until BHA Level\n(vs. 100k iterations)",
       color = "BHA Level",
       shape = "System") +
  scale_color_scico_d()
```
